1.21.1.1.2.4: Fix: players were disconnected from a server with Krypton ('a frame cut inside a container', since 1.2.3).
1.21.1.1.2.3: See and choose what Sleepium does to each mod (Options -> Sleepium -> Mods), what each mod costs and where the server's time goes, a pack settings file for modpack makers, Find the cause, a HUD; fix: joining with Krypton.
1.21.1.1.2.2: Thermal dynamos and other mods' machines no longer stop under Sleepium's sleep (since 1.2.0); sounds no longer stall the game (a heavy sound mod's horde 11 -> 41 fps); measured choices kept per machine; no join stalls on Intel; the log names the mod Sleepium gave way to.
1.21.1.1.2.1: Android (MojoLauncher, OpenGL 3.3): no crash at start, a phone's entity scene 8 -> 42-58 fps, terrain 147 -> 222; F3 no longer halves the frame rate; choices measured on the running game; desktops as fast as 1.2.0, the same picture.
1.21.1.1.2.0: Intel graphics about 1.4x faster on terrain (direct chunk draws); particles up to 2x; machines' moving parts from the GPU; smoother frames; mods' idle machines sleep (report problems); a crash next to Bons and Furious fixed; experimental GPU terrain with LOD.
1.21.1.1.1.11: World generation with datapacks like JJThunder To The Max up to 2x faster (height-independent climate values computed once per column; same world).
1.21.1.1.1.10: Fixes world generation far from the centre being slower than vanilla (64 000 blocks out: 20-34 -> 123-126 chunks/s; vanilla 55), long teleports too; moving blocks' light a frame late.
1.21.1.1.1.9: Fixes 1.1.8 being slower next to ImmediatelyFast (dropped items 498 -> 1 765 fps); mods' entities added from a world-generation thread go where they belong; ObservedModSleep (off by default).
1.21.1.1.1.8: Dropped items drawn by the graphics card (about 2x fps with many items), cheaper collisions for orbs and items (exact), a documented sleepium.properties for servers, an ASM fix.
1.21.1.1.1.7: Fixes a crash when drawing entities with EntityBatch switched off; the same hooks fix as 1.20.1.
1.21.1.1.1.6: Fixes singleplayer worlds taking minutes to open next to ModernFix and mods that wait for server data while loading (ALI + JEI); "part of" switches in the settings take you to their parent.
1.21.1.1.1.5: Fixes joining online-mode servers (hung on Encrypting...), crashes next to mods that change the entity render call or reach into the event bus (Gnetum).
1.21.1.1.1.4: Fixes world creation crashing with very tall worldgen datapacks (JJThunder To The Max) and chunk saving failing next to C2ME.
1.21.1.1.1.3: Event hooks next to other mods: no conflicts and the speed-up back; entity sleep next to mods that inject into entities; the render cache learns fields that don't change the picture.
1.21.1.1.1.2: The settings screen works again (every switch was locked and shown OFF since 1.1.0).
1.21.1.1.1.1: Fixes a NeoForge server not starting next to mods that wrap NeoForge event posts (VerifyError in CommonHooks); EMF hook optional.
1.21.1.1.1.0: Works with Lithium, Radium, ModernFix, Iris, Embeddium and ImmediatelyFast without losing its gains; burning entities on the render workers; faster interpolated textures.
1.21.1.1.0.3: Works with Lithium, Moonrise, C2ME, ModernFix and Embeddium (they crashed with 1.0.2); water and glass in one draw (about 2x fps over water); water lit by light volumes.
1.21.1.1.0.2: A new settings screen with a live overview, presets and stats; shaderpack options screens; applying pack options without a break.
1.21.1.1.0.1: Shaderpacks prepared over frames (no freeze on a driver's first compile); the settings screen shows which flags switch which; the mod list's logo, links and update check.

1.20.1.1.2.4: The same network fix as 1.21.1 (Krypton Reno on 1.20.1 was not affected).
1.20.1.1.2.3: See and choose what Sleepium does to each mod (Options -> Sleepium -> Mods), what each mod costs and where the server's time goes, a pack settings file for modpack makers, Find the cause, a HUD; fix: joining with Krypton.
1.20.1.1.2.2: The same as 1.21.1; the Thermal series checked (its dynamos stayed off with fuel in under 1.2.0-1.2.1).
1.20.1.1.2.1: The same as 1.21.1 (measured on the phone with 1.20.1), plus armour texture paths kept instead of formatted every frame.
1.20.1.1.2.0: The same as 1.21.1, plus mobs with Entity Model Features 3.3.12 drawn on several threads (1 440 animated mobs 25 -> 43 fps).
1.20.1.1.1.11: The same as 1.21.1: world generation with tall datapacks up to 2x faster, same world.
1.20.1.1.1.10: The same fixes as 1.21.1; blocks moved by pistons drawn from a cache (790-979 -> 1 515-1 552 fps on a piston scene).
1.20.1.1.1.9: The same as 1.21.1: next to ImmediatelyFast items and transparent entities go to the graphics card again (159 -> 718 fps on an items scene); entities added from a world-generation thread; ObservedModSleep (off).
1.20.1.1.1.8: The same as 1.21.1: items drawn by the graphics card, cheaper collisions, the config file for servers; the settings screen shows the 56 missing switches.
1.20.1.1.1.7: Fixes the server reacting up to a tick late next to ModernFix, and a startup crash next to some mods (Immersive Fixes).
1.20.1.1.1.6: Fixes singleplayer worlds taking minutes to open next to ModernFix and mods that wait for server data while loading (ALI + JEI); "part of" switches in the settings take you to their parent.
1.20.1.1.1.5: Fixes crashes next to mods that change the entity render call or reach into the event bus (Gnetum).
1.20.1.1.1.4: Fixes world creation crashing with very tall worldgen datapacks and chunk saving failing next to C2ME.
1.20.1.1.1.3: The same as 1.21.1: event hooks next to other mods, entity sleep next to mods that inject into entities (Collections Of Optimizations), render cache field learning.
1.20.1.1.1.2: The settings screen works again (every switch was locked and shown OFF).
1.20.1.1.1.1: The same fixes as 1.21.1: event sites next to mods that wrap them; the EMF hook optional.
1.20.1.1.1.0: The first release for Minecraft 1.20.1 / Forge.
